description: 切割者（slasher）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 切割者

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. a slasher, lean and hunched forward, about six and a half heads tall: a dark red-grey combat suit with light armor on the chest and one shoulder, a smooth face mask with a thin glowing red visor line, the near arm ends in a long blade instead of a hand, black boots.
